existing_evaluation.replay_caution: Only 17 inputs rerun in matched original/corrected pairs. The aggregate reuses 1533 cached predictions; 2 have updated labels. Fresh-original vs cached differences are explicitly exposed; do not attribute them to label corrections.

evaluation.separation: Natural cases share no 8-char target span with audited local corpora or each other; controlled full surrounding texts do not occur in those corpora; topic groups do not cross dev/heldout.
evaluation.freeze: Inputs and labels hashed before inference. Dev none-pool selected ranking. All sealed predictions completed under selection hash before labels parsed for scoring.
evaluation.heldout_status: Opened once for this prespecified experiment; do not tune further on it and present that as another blind result.
evaluation.source_attribution: Natural sentences: Tatoeba IDs retained; export attribution/license in neural/japanese-sources.json. Controlled cases are assistant-authored.

protocol.qwen_context: production last 64 chars and Japanese neutral prefix
protocol.score: zenz summed logprob including EOS; Qwen summed logprob without EOS
protocol.timing: paired generation/scoring, pooled Qwen batch; not interactive latency
protocol.validation: production Table.spells; no unvalidated model candidates

selected.selection: dev none-pool NFKC top1; ties baseline, no length norm, nearest baseline weight

experiment.interpretation: Right context improves these controlled ambiguity cases. The lower Qwen weight gains only one natural heldout case; not sufficient evidence to change the global default.
post_unseal_observations: Left-only Qwen scoring can override right-informed zenz decisions, e.g. 紙/髪 and 公害/郊外. This is a next-experiment hypothesis, not a post-hoc setting change.
Reference alternatives are finite: context-sealed-080 mixed 3本/二冊 is reasonable but not listed. No labels or scores were changed after unsealing.
Some designed ambiguities admit wider readings (e.g. 保証/補償の期間); controlled-set gain is not a natural-distribution accuracy estimate.
Timing is pooled/offline scoring, not editor latency. No production default, right-context UI integration or model weights changed.
